_note: CICTT Level 1 parent categories used in the trial. Definitions are short paraphrases for the trial; production loads the official CICTT text (US 311617, IN-2). in_scope follows US 311617 Section 9.

categories.name: Runway Incursion
categories.definition: Incorrect presence of an aircraft, vehicle or person on the protected area of a surface designated for the landing and takeoff of aircraft. Includes entering or crossing a runway without clearance.
categories.team_note: In the SEWG pilot, landing or takeoff on an unintended surface (taxiway, closed or wrong runway, wrong airport) is decomposed under RI (US 311617).

categories.name: Runway Excursion
categories.definition: An aircraft veers off the side of the runway or overruns the end of the runway during takeoff or landing.

categories.name: Abnormal Runway Contact
categories.definition: Any landing or takeoff involving abnormal contact with the runway or landing surface, such as hard landings, bounced landings, tail strikes and wing or nacelle strikes.

categories.name: Loss of Control – Inflight
categories.definition: Loss of aircraft control or an extreme deviation from the intended flight path while in flight, including stalls and upsets.

categories.name: Airprox / ACAS alert / loss of separation / near midair / midair collision
categories.definition: Airprox, ACAS or TCAS alerts, loss of separation, and near or actual midair collisions between aircraft in flight.

categories.name: Turbulence Encounter
categories.definition: In-flight encounter with turbulence, including clear-air, mountain wave, convective and wake turbulence.

categories.name: System/Component Failure – Powerplant
categories.definition: Failure or malfunction of an aircraft system or component related to the powerplant, including engine shutdown, surge, loss of thrust and engine fire.

categories.name: System/Component Failure – Non-Powerplant
categories.definition: Failure or malfunction of an aircraft system or component other than the powerplant, such as flight instruments, pitot-static and air data systems.

categories.name: Bird
categories.definition: Occurrence involving a collision or near collision with birds, including bird ingestion into engines.

categories.name: Icing
categories.definition: Accumulation of snow, ice, freezing rain or frost on aircraft surfaces or sensors that adversely affects control, performance or instrument indications, including ground de-icing issues.

categories.name: Controlled Flight Into or Toward Terrain
categories.definition: In-flight collision or near collision with terrain, water or an obstacle without indication of loss of control, including terrain warnings.

categories.name: Cabin Safety Events
categories.definition: Occurrences in the passenger cabin of transport aircraft, including injuries to passengers or cabin crew and unsecured carts or galley equipment.

categories.name: Navigation Error
categories.definition: Navigating the aircraft incorrectly, including deviations from the cleared route or altitude and landing at the wrong airport.

categories.name: ATM/CNS
categories.definition: Occurrences involving air traffic management or communication, navigation and surveillance services, such as controller errors or clearance misunderstandings.
